previous_admission_summary.summary_paragraph: The patient was admitted for evaluation of elevated creatinine (2.9 mg/dL) from her baseline of 1.7, detected during a routine transplant clinic visit. She was asymptomatic. Ultrasound revealed mild hydronephrosis and elevated resistive indices, prompting a kidney biopsy which confirmed acute humoral rejection. Treatment included plasmapheresis with a tunneled catheter, high-dose IV steroids tapered to oral prednisone, and four doses of ATG. Due to steroid-induced hyperglycemia, glipizide and Humalog insulin were initiated. Hypertension, worsened by fluid overload and steroids, was managed by increasing labetalol and adding furosemide, while lisinopril was held. Tacrolimus was increased to 6.5 mg twice daily. The patient remained stable, with creatinine plateauing at 2.6 mg/dL. She was discharged home with medication adjustments and close follow-up.

Brief Hospital Course:
___ year old woman with CKD s/p transplant, hypertension, 
Hyperlipidemia, Moderate AS, is admitted with worsening dyspnea 
and chest pain for condiseration of cardiac catheterization. She 
had right and left catheterization which showed two vessel 
coronary artery disease in addition to moderate aortic stenosis 
and slightly elevated left sided filling pressures (PCWP 
14mmHg). DES was placed in left mid circumflex artery and 
discharged in stable condition, with follow up.

# Unstable angina: She reported left sided chest pain which 
occurs at rest and with exertion which was concerning for 
unstable angina. Initial thought was that this is related to 
myocardial ishcemia vs Aortic stenosis. Cathterization and 
stenting were performed as mentioned above. She was prepared 
with bicarb prior to catheterization. We continued her home 
medications (labetalol, aspirin 325 mg, rosuvostatin and 
ezetimibe)and uptitrated lisinopril to 10 mg daily. Plavix was 
initiated.

# Hypertension: previously difficult to treat, lisinopril 
recently added which was uptitrated to 10 mg daily on this 
admission. We continued Amlodipine 10mg daily.
